name: marketing-scraping
description: Market-research tools you run on your own Apify account for when you want: App Store or Play Store reviews for a product, Google Maps/Trustpilot/Reddit/G2/Capterra reviews of a competitor, competitor ad analysis across Meta/Google/LinkedIn, or real keyword volume and SERP data. Every number is counted in code before any LLM runs. The review and keyword tools then write a numbered report; the ad tool prepares a report bundle for your own model to fill in. Results open in a local app on your own computer, where you can browse every record and work through them with Claude.
